data.name: Dhawal
data.gender_notes: Dhawal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dhawal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhau' which means 'sun'. The name signifies the rising sun and represents new beginnings, light, and energy. The name Dhawal carries the meaning “Rising Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhawal usually hope their child will grow to embody rising sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhawal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rising Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhawal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhawal is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing the virile and powerful aspect of the sun deity Surya. As the sun rises every morning, it symbolizes the beginning of a new day, bringing warmth, energy, and light to the world. The name Dhawal thus carries the auspicious and invigorating essence of the sun, signifying vitality and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Dhawal signifies enlightenment, illumination, and wisdom. The rising sun represents the rising of the soul from the depths of ignorance to the heights of knowledge and understanding. It also signifies the 'inner sun' in each individual, representing the awakened self that is filled with the radiance of the divine. Thus, the name Dhawal holds immense spiritual significance, symbolizing the journey of the soul towards self-realization and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dhawal: Radiating purity and brilliance like the crystal-clear morning sky. Embodiment of truth and righteousness.
